findings.highlight: he was simply waiting for me to bring it up
findings.evidenceJa: …それほどまでに、その頃のわたしの様子はただごとじゃなかったのかもしれない。
findings.explanation: The supervisor accepts Setsuna's leave because her condition was plainly extraordinary. Todokanai TL invents the further motive that he had been waiting for her to mention it.
findings.japanese:
…それほどまでに、その頃のわたしの様子は
ただごとじゃなかったのかもしれない。
findings.todokanai: …Maybe that's just how terrible of a state I was in, and he was simply waiting for me to bring it up.

findings.highlight: So there's no problem anymore. Everything's back to normal.
findings.evidenceJa: だからもう、全く問題ない。何もかも元通り。まずは今までの平日を取り戻し、すぐに今までの週末も取り戻す。
findings.explanation: Setsuna specifies the recovery program: first reclaim her former weekdays, then soon reclaim her former weekends. Todokanai TL stops at a generic return to normal and omits both stages.
findings.japanese:
だからもう、全く問題ない。何もかも元通り。
まずは今までの平日を取り戻し、
すぐに今までの週末も取り戻す。
findings.todokanai: So there's no problem anymore. Everything's back to normal.

findings.highlight: I woke up late at night one day feeling thirsty, so I went downstairs for a drink.
findings.evidenceJa: 真夜中に喉が渇いて目が覚め、階下に降りたとき、真っ暗な台所で、力なく静かに涙するお母さんの姿を。
findings.explanation: The sentence culminates in Setsuna seeing her mother quietly and weakly crying alone in the pitch-dark kitchen. Todokanai TL translates only the trip downstairs and deletes the image that changes Setsuna's understanding of her family.
findings.japanese:
真夜中に喉が渇いて目が覚め、階下に降りたとき、
真っ暗な台所で、力なく静かに涙するお母さんの姿を。
findings.todokanai: I woke up late at night one day feeling thirsty, so I went downstairs for a drink.

findings.highlight: blow at the barley tea
findings.evidenceJa: テーブルに座り、コップに注いだ麦茶を一気にあおる。
findings.explanation: Setsuna gulps the barley tea down in one go. Todokanai TL has her blow on the cold drink instead.
findings.japanese: テーブルに座り、コップに注いだ麦茶を一気にあおる。
findings.todokanai: I sit down by the table and blow at the barley tea in my cup.

findings.highlight: a jealous woman like me
findings.evidenceJa: …こんな、猜疑心の強い女の子、彼に相応しくないのかな。
findings.explanation: Setsuna calls herself distrustful or excessively suspicious. Todokanai TL substitutes jealousy, changing the specific fault she fears makes her unworthy of Haruki.
findings.japanese:
…こんな、猜疑心の強い女の子、
彼に相応しくないのかな。
findings.todokanai: …Is a jealous woman like me even a good match for him?

findings.highlight: taking on the world again
findings.evidenceJa: 「冬馬かずさ、新たな世界への挑戦」
findings.explanation: The headline frames Kazusa as challenging a new world. Todokanai TL adds 'again' and turns the new-world threshold into a repeated attempt to take on the existing world.
findings.japanese: 「冬馬かずさ、新たな世界への挑戦」
findings.todokanai: "Touma Kazusa, taking on the world again."

findings.highlight: Guess who I just saw on the news
findings.evidenceJa: 『それとさっきニュースでさ…』
findings.explanation: Setsuna recalls the earlier words 'and earlier, on the news.' Todokanai TL rewrites the quotation as a reveal about seeing a person, damaging an exact callback and inventing suspense absent from the source.
findings.japanese: 『それとさっきニュースでさ…』
findings.todokanai: "Guess who I just saw on the news…"

findings.highlight: European branch
findings.evidenceJa: 「お急ぎのご用がありましたら、冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部に連絡をお願いします。電話番号は…」
findings.explanation: The recorded message names the Touma Youko Office's European headquarters. Todokanai TL calls it a branch, reversing the organization's hierarchy.
findings.japanese:
「お急ぎのご用がありましたら、
冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部に連絡をお願いします。
電話番号は…」
findings.todokanai: "If you have urgent business, please contact the European branch of Touma Youko Office. The number to them is…"

findings.highlight: online games on their smartphones
findings.evidenceJa: 金管は相変わらずカードに興じ、木管はもう少し近代的に、日本の携帯ゲーム機で通信対戦を楽しみ始めた。
findings.explanation: The woodwinds use Japanese handheld game consoles for local wireless competitive play. Todokanai TL changes both the devices and the play mode to smartphones and online games.
findings.japanese:
金管は相変わらずカードに興じ、
木管はもう少し近代的に、
日本の携帯ゲーム機で通信対戦を楽しみ始めた。
findings.todokanai: The brass crew were still playing cards in the back, while the woodwinds, slightly more modern, were playing online games on their smartphones instead.

findings.highlight: In truth, no one could complain if they got angry instead and left the project.
findings.evidenceJa: 本来なら、彼らの方が怒って来なくなっても当然なのに、あたしの途切れ途切れのピアノと、粘着指揮者の罵倒をさらりと聞き流しつつ日々無駄な時間を消費している。
findings.explanation: The sentence continues that the musicians nevertheless waste their days casually ignoring Kazusa's broken playing and the obsessive conductor's abuse. Todokanai TL omits the entire action that demonstrates their patience.
findings.japanese:
本来なら、彼らの方が怒って来なくなっても当然なのに、
あたしの途切れ途切れのピアノと、粘着指揮者の罵倒を
さらりと聞き流しつつ日々無駄な時間を消費している。
findings.todokanai: In truth, no one could complain if they got angry instead and left the project.

findings.highlight: The moment that piece of news reached his ears
findings.evidenceJa: そして、そんなふうに黒字が保証された途端、奴の態度は豹変した。
findings.explanation: The impresario's attitude changes precisely once the concert's profitability is guaranteed. Todokanai TL replaces the financial cause with the mere arrival of unspecified news.
findings.japanese:
そして、そんなふうに黒字が保証された途端、
奴の態度は豹変した。
findings.todokanai: The moment that piece of news reached his ears, his attitude fully altered course.

findings.highlight: To think there are companies willing to throw a fortune down the drain for a mediocre pianist like you…
findings.evidenceJa: 「こんな下手なピアニストのために大金をドブに捨てる企業があるとは…私も日本人に生まれたかったね、実に残念だ」
findings.explanation: Dupre continues that he wishes he had been born Japanese and finds that fact truly regrettable. Todokanai TL omits the nationality punchline and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「こんな下手なピアニストのために
大金をドブに捨てる企業があるとは…
私も日本人に生まれたかったね、実に残念だ」
findings.todokanai: "To think there are companies willing to throw a fortune down the drain for a mediocre pianist like you…

findings.highlight: why do I have to deal with this guy
findings.evidenceJa: 本当にさ…なんで一時期とは言え、あんな奴と…
findings.explanation: Kazusa is incredulously addressing Youko's former involvement with Dupre: why, even for a time, was her mother with a man like that? Todokanai TL instead complains that Kazusa herself must deal with him once.
findings.japanese:
本当にさ…
なんで一時期とは言え、あんな奴と…
findings.todokanai: Seriously… I know it's only this one time, but why do I have to deal with this guy…?

findings.highlight: Do I really look that unserious
findings.evidenceJa: 『なぁ、母さん…あたしのピアノって、やっぱりお遊戯なのかな？』
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks whether her piano is really no more than a children's amusement or recital. Todokanai TL turns the artistic judgment into a question about whether she looks unserious while playing.
findings.japanese:
『なぁ、母さん…
あたしのピアノって、やっぱりお遊戯なのかな？』
findings.todokanai: "Tell me, Mom… Do I really look that unserious when I'm playing the piano?"

findings.highlight: it can only play along with the violins
findings.evidenceJa: 『本物のオケの音に跳ね返される。…まだヴァイオリンしか相手にしてないのに』
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the real orchestra's sound repels her piano even though she has faced only the violins so far. Todokanai TL changes her being overwhelmed into a limitation on what her piano can accompany.
findings.japanese:
『本物のオケの音に跳ね返される。
…まだヴァイオリンしか相手にしてないのに』
findings.todokanai: "The sound of a real orchestra is repelling it… So far, it can only play along with the violins."

findings.highlight: Tell me I'm fine. Tell me I'll succeed. Tell me Mom will get better.
findings.evidenceJa: あたしは大丈夫だって、絶対に成功するって、母さんは元気になるって、嘘でもいいから、言ってよ…
findings.explanation: Kazusa explicitly begs Youko to say these reassurances even if they are lies. Todokanai TL omits that condition, which is the measure of her desperation.
findings.japanese:
あたしは大丈夫だって、
絶対に成功するって、母さんは元気になるって、
嘘でもいいから、言ってよ…
findings.todokanai: Tell me I'm fine. Tell me I'll succeed. Tell me Mom will get better.

findings.highlight: becoming unable to comfort him
findings.evidenceJa: そしてわたしが、折れてしまいそうな今。彼を、支えきれなくなってしまいそうな、今…
findings.explanation: Setsuna fears she is becoming unable to keep supporting Haruki as she approaches collapse. Todokanai TL narrows that sustained practical and emotional support to comforting him.
findings.japanese:
そしてわたしが、折れてしまいそうな今。
彼を、支えきれなくなってしまいそうな、今…
findings.todokanai: And… now when I'm nearing my breaking point. Now when I'm becoming unable to comfort him…

findings.highlight: the excitement in my voice is slipping out
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の浮き立つ声が、あからさまに滑ってるのがわかる。
findings.explanation: Setsuna hears her deliberately buoyant voice falling conspicuously flat. Todokanai TL instead says genuine excitement is escaping into her voice, reversing the failure of her performance.
findings.japanese: 自分の浮き立つ声が、あからさまに滑ってるのがわかる。
findings.todokanai: I know how clearly the excitement in my voice is slipping out.

findings.highlight: It's absurd that I'm doing this, when I shouldn't even have the right to call you.
findings.evidenceJa: 「あたし、お前に電話できる資格なんかないのに。なのに、こんな厚かましい真似…」
findings.explanation: Kazusa continues that despite lacking any right to call, she is committing an act this shameless. Todokanai TL drops the self-indicting second movement.
findings.japanese:
「あたし、お前に電話できる資格なんかないのに。
なのに、こんな厚かましい真似…」
findings.todokanai: "It's absurd that I'm doing this, when I shouldn't even have the right to call you."

findings.highlight: my defeat was certain from the start
findings.evidenceJa: 彼のことを話すために、かずさと連絡を取ろうとしてたのに。…最初から、負けるつもり、だったのに。
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she had intended to lose from the beginning. Todokanai TL changes a deliberate self-sacrificial plan into a prediction that defeat was inevitable.
findings.japanese:
彼のことを話すために、
かずさと連絡を取ろうとしてたのに。
…最初から、負けるつもり、だったのに。
findings.todokanai: Even though that was the reason I called her in the first place… Even though my defeat was certain from the start.

findings.highlight: He was in Houjou High all this time yet he couldn't get a single recommendation.
findings.evidenceJa: 「優秀だなんて全然。せっかく付属にいたのに推薦すら取れなくて一般入試でギリギリだったんだから」
findings.explanation: Setsuna adds that Haruki only barely passed through the ordinary entrance examination. Todokanai TL omits the concrete academic calibration and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「優秀だなんて全然。
せっかく付属にいたのに推薦すら取れなくて
一般入試でギリギリだったんだから」
findings.todokanai: "He's not exemplary at all. He was in Houjou High all this time yet he couldn't get a single recommendation.

findings.highlight: What are you talking about
findings.evidenceJa: 「なんでそんなことになってんだよ！？」
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks how things came to be this way. Todokanai TL instead asks what Setsuna is talking about, changing shock at the situation into failure to understand her words.
findings.japanese: 「なんでそんなことになってんだよ！？」
findings.todokanai: "What are you talking about!?"

findings.highlight: having the time of your life in Europe
findings.evidenceJa: 「何言ってるのよ！そっちはヨーロッパでも大活躍してるくせに！」
findings.explanation: Setsuna says Kazusa is thriving or achieving greatly in Europe. Todokanai TL turns professional success into personal enjoyment.
findings.japanese:
「何言ってるのよ！
そっちはヨーロッパでも大活躍してるくせに！」
findings.todokanai: "What are you saying!? You're having the time of your life in Europe!"

findings.highlight: I don't care!
findings.evidenceJa: 「知らないよ！そんなの、全部背負いきれないよ！わたしは春希くんだけだよ！」
findings.explanation: Setsuna cries that she does not know how to answer or carry all of this. Todokanai TL says she does not care, making her reject concerns she is actually overwhelmed by.
findings.japanese:
「知らないよ！
そんなの、全部背負いきれないよ！
わたしは春希くんだけだよ！」
findings.todokanai: "I don't care! I can't take responsibility for everything! The only one who matters to me is Haruki-kun!"

findings.highlight: shifting responsibility,
findings.evidenceJa: 自己正当化、理不尽な罵倒、聞こえないふり、大泣き、責任転嫁、悲劇のヒロイン気取り…
findings.explanation: The list continues through outright sobbing and ends with playing the tragic heroine. Todokanai TL weakens the sobbing to whining, omits the tragic-heroine item, and leaves the sentence open.
findings.japanese:
自己正当化、理不尽な罵倒、聞こえないふり、
大泣き、責任転嫁、悲劇のヒロイン気取り…
findings.todokanai: We're justifying ourselves, we're unreasonably lashing out at each other, we're whining, we're pretending not to hear one another, shifting responsibility,

findings.highlight: I'm suffering many times more than you are
findings.evidenceJa: 「もうすぐコンサートなんだぞ？それに母さんだって…雪菜なんかより数倍苦しい思いしてるんだぞ？」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says her mother is suffering several times more than Setsuna. Todokanai TL makes Kazusa herself the comparative sufferer.
findings.japanese:
「もうすぐコンサートなんだぞ？
それに母さんだって…
雪菜なんかより数倍苦しい思いしてるんだぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "My concert is right around the corner, and my mom… I'm suffering many times more than you are, Setsuna."

findings.highlight: Setsuna isn't holding back
findings.evidenceJa: だから雪菜も、いつも通りに引き留めない。
findings.explanation: Setsuna does not try to hold Kazusa back, as usual. Todokanai TL says Setsuna herself is not holding back, assigning the verb to the wrong participant and action.
findings.japanese: だから雪菜も、いつも通りに引き留めない。
findings.todokanai: That's why Setsuna isn't holding back like she usually does.

findings.highlight: then go past the main gate of Houjou University and Houjou High from there,
findings.evidenceJa: マンションから、南末次の駅を通り過ぎ、峰城大の正門や、付属の正門も通り過ぎ、その先にある、川沿いの土手。
findings.explanation: The destination is the riverbank embankment beyond both gates. Todokanai TL omits the destination, leaves the sentence at a comma, and deprives the next paragraph of its named setting.
findings.japanese:
マンションから、南末次の駅を通り過ぎ、
峰城大の正門や、付属の正門も通り過ぎ、
その先にある、川沿いの土手。
findings.todokanai: If you go past Minami-Suetsugu station from the apartment, then go past the main gate of Houjou University and Houjou High from there,

findings.highlight: Takeya would take naps here when he was skipping class.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ここさ、付属の正門から近いだろ？武也がよく学校サボって昼寝してたんだよな。ま、俺は帰りにあいつを起こす役だったけど」
findings.explanation: Haruki adds that he was the one assigned to wake Takeya on his way home. Todokanai TL omits the role that completes their school-days anecdote and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「ここさ、付属の正門から近いだろ？
武也がよく学校サボって昼寝してたんだよな。
ま、俺は帰りにあいつを起こす役だったけど」
findings.todokanai: "This place is close to the main gate of Houjou High. Takeya would take naps here when he was skipping class.

findings.highlight: Don't push yourself to the edge for my sake ever again.
findings.evidenceJa: 「じゃあ、普段の俺っぽい説教も一つ。…二度と、俺のために壊れるまで我慢するな。どうせ大した意味はないんだから」
findings.explanation: Haruki adds that destroying herself for him will not accomplish much anyway. Todokanai TL drops the deliberately harsh conclusion that provokes Setsuna's reply and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「じゃあ、普段の俺っぽい説教も一つ。
…二度と、俺のために壊れるまで我慢するな。
どうせ大した意味はないんだから」
findings.todokanai: "Then let me give you a piece of my mind like my usual self would: …Don't push yourself to the edge for my sake ever again.

findings.highlight: I've done all this of my own volition
findings.evidenceJa: その、押し隠した表情で確信できた。自分が、自分の言動をできているって。
findings.explanation: Haruki recognizes from Setsuna's reaction that he is once again able to speak and behave as himself; the next line names remaining Kitahara Haruki. Todokanai TL changes recovered identity into merely having acted voluntarily.
findings.japanese:
その、押し隠した表情で確信できた。
自分が、自分の言動をできているって。
findings.todokanai: And it's that concealed expression that's allowed me to be sureーbe sure of the fact that I've done all this of my own volition.

findings.highlight: the ability to muster my own effort
findings.evidenceJa: 薬に診療、周囲の理解、尽力、そして、時間の経過。
findings.explanation: The list credits the understanding and efforts of the people around Haruki. Todokanai TL reassigns those efforts to Haruki himself.
findings.japanese:
薬に診療、
周囲の理解、尽力、
そして、時間の経過。
findings.todokanai: I needed medication, understanding from my surroundings, the ability to muster my own effort, as well as the passage of time.

findings.highlight: My symptoms didn't get worse when Setsuna disappeared from my life,
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜がいなくなったから症状が悪化したとか、あるいは逆に、雪菜が潰れかけたことを責任に感じて、今まで以上に頑張って克服したとか、そんなことはなく。
findings.explanation: Haruki denies two dramatic explanations: Setsuna's departure did not worsen him, and guilt over her near-collapse did not make him strive harder than before. Todokanai TL keeps only the first denial and leaves the sentence open.
findings.japanese:
雪菜がいなくなったから症状が悪化したとか、
あるいは逆に、雪菜が潰れかけたことを責任に感じて、
今まで以上に頑張って克服したとか、そんなことはなく。
findings.todokanai: My symptoms didn't get worse when Setsuna disappeared from my life,

findings.highlight: I needed Setsuna's understanding and support, but it wasn't the deciding factor;
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の理解や支えは必要だったけれど必須ではなく、雪菜の無理や離脱は痛恨だったけれど致命的ではなく。
findings.explanation: Haruki continues that Setsuna's overexertion and withdrawal were deeply painful but not fatal to his recovery. Todokanai TL omits the second half of the paired argument.
findings.japanese:
雪菜の理解や支えは必要だったけれど必須ではなく、
雪菜の無理や離脱は痛恨だったけれど致命的ではなく。
findings.todokanai: I needed Setsuna's understanding and support, but it wasn't the deciding factor;

findings.highlight: you should consider some counseling yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 「極論から極論に走るなぁ、雪菜は。今度、一緒にカウンセリング受けるか？」
findings.explanation: Haruki asks whether he and Setsuna should attend counseling together next time. Todokanai TL sends Setsuna to counseling alone, removing his inclusion in the proposed treatment.
findings.japanese:
「極論から極論に走るなぁ、雪菜は。
今度、一緒にカウンセリング受けるか？」
findings.todokanai: "You're going from one extreme conclusion to another, Setsuna. Maybe you should consider some counseling yourself."

findings.highlight: has no manners to speak of
findings.evidenceJa: …こっちの客は本気でマナーにうるさいから、音だけで観客数を読むことはできなかったんだけど、それでもこの数は想定外だった。
findings.explanation: The local audience is extremely strict about concert manners and therefore too quiet for Kazusa to estimate its size by sound. Todokanai TL says the audience has no manners, exactly reversing the explanation.
findings.japanese:
…こっちの客は本気でマナーにうるさいから、
音だけで観客数を読むことはできなかったんだけど、
それでもこの数は想定外だった。
findings.todokanai: The audience here has no manners to speak of, so it's hard to judge how many there are by sound alone, but this is far more than I ever could have imagined.

findings.highlight: after having carried two giant speakers into her hospital room
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ、フリューゲルからな。今ごろ、病室に巨大スピーカーを持ち込んで、二人でテレビにかじりついている頃だ」
findings.explanation: 二人 refers to Flügel and Youko, who are glued to the television in her hospital room. Todokanai TL instead attaches the two to the speakers and omits the television action. Because Japanese does not obligatorily mark number on スピーカー, the finding does not separately claim that the source proves exactly one speaker.
findings.japanese:
「ああ、フリューゲルからな。
今ごろ、病室に巨大スピーカーを持ち込んで、
二人でテレビにかじりついている頃だ」
findings.todokanai: "Yes, from Fluegel. I believe he's with her right now, after having carried two giant speakers into her hospital room."

findings.highlight: for Mom's sake
findings.evidenceJa: あたしの知らないところで、あたしの知らない色んな人たちが、あたしと母さんのために動いてたってことなのか？
findings.explanation: Kazusa realizes that many people unknown to her have been acting for both her and her mother. Todokanai TL omits Kazusa from the beneficiaries, weakening her discovery that she was never working alone.
findings.japanese:
あたしの知らないところで、
あたしの知らない色んな人たちが、
あたしと母さんのために動いてたってことなのか？
findings.todokanai: Could it be that there are people that I don't know, working in ways that I'm not aware of for Mom's sake?

findings.highlight: Isn't the fruits of my own labor
findings.evidenceJa: あたしは、一人で頑張ってた訳じゃないのか…？
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks whether she was not, after all, striving alone. Todokanai TL produces an ungrammatical fragment that instead asserts the concert is the fruit of her own labor, reversing the realization.
findings.japanese: あたしは、一人で頑張ってた訳じゃないのか…？
findings.todokanai: Isn't the fruits of my own labor…?

findings.highlight: You were already at the age of one when I had the pleasure of meeting your mother…
findings.evidenceJa: 「彼女と知り合った時、君はちょうど一歳だった。…その頃のヨウコは、小さな赤ん坊を抱っこしたまま世界中を回っていたよ」
findings.explanation: Dupre continues that Youko was then traveling the world while carrying infant Kazusa. Todokanai TL deletes the history that supports his claim to have known Kazusa since babyhood.
findings.japanese:
「彼女と知り合った時、君はちょうど一歳だった。
…その頃のヨウコは、小さな赤ん坊を抱っこしたまま
世界中を回っていたよ」
findings.todokanai: "You were already at the age of one when I had the pleasure of meeting your mother…

findings.highlight: she'd always go straight to sleep at the sound of Youko's piano.
findings.evidenceJa: 「手のかからない子でね、どれだけ泣いていても、ヨウコが弾くとすぐに眠ってしまうんだ。将来絶対ピアニストになると、彼女の自慢の種だった」
findings.explanation: Dupre adds that Youko proudly claimed the baby would certainly become a pianist. Todokanai TL omits the maternal boast that connects infancy to Kazusa's present concert.
findings.japanese:
「手のかからない子でね、どれだけ泣いていても、
ヨウコが弾くとすぐに眠ってしまうんだ。
将来絶対ピアニストになると、彼女の自慢の種だった」
findings.todokanai: "She was rather easy to handle for a baby. No matter how much she cried, she'd always go straight to sleep at the sound of Youko's piano.

findings.highlight: I'll start it, okay?
findings.evidenceJa: 「始まる、ね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna observes that the broadcast or concert is starting. Todokanai TL makes her say she will start it herself and adds a request for assent.
findings.japanese: 「始まる、ね」
findings.todokanai: "I'll start it, okay?"

findings.highlight: those that split us apart
findings.evidenceJa: 今、ここにいる二人の気持ちが裂けてしまいそうだったあの時とは、違う。
findings.explanation: The earlier scene was one in which the feelings of the two people here seemed about to tear apart. Todokanai TL says those feelings actually split them apart, changing a threatened rupture into a completed one.
findings.japanese:
今、ここにいる二人の気持ちが
裂けてしまいそうだったあの時とは、違う。
findings.todokanai: The feelings of the two people sitting here today… are nothing like those that split us apart half a year ago.

findings.highlight: dragging me down to hell with you
findings.evidenceJa: 「たとえ破滅するってわかってても、わたしと一緒に堕ちていきたいって、思わなかったの？」
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether Haruki ever wanted to fall together with her even knowing it meant ruin. Todokanai TL makes him the sole agent dragging her down, replacing mutual descent with coercion.
findings.japanese:
「たとえ破滅するってわかってても、
わたしと一緒に堕ちていきたいって、思わなかったの？」
findings.todokanai: "Even if you knew you were beyond saving, didn't you ever think of dragging me down to hell with you?"

findings.highlight: You would've forced Kazusa to be yours
findings.evidenceJa: 「…かずさなら、無理やり奪うよね？一緒に堕ちても、構わないって思うよね？」
findings.explanation: Setsuna says Kazusa would forcibly take Haruki and would accept falling together with him. Todokanai TL reverses the subject, making Haruki force Kazusa to be his and drag her down.
findings.japanese:
「…かずさなら、無理やり奪うよね？
一緒に堕ちても、構わないって思うよね？」
findings.todokanai: "…You would've forced Kazusa to be yours. You wouldn't have minded dragging her to hell with you."

findings.highlight: It's the same brash tone you had in the past
findings.evidenceJa: 「さっきから春希くん、わたしのこと、お前って言ってる。ずっと、言ってるよ…」
findings.explanation: Setsuna explicitly notices that Haruki has repeatedly called her お前 since they met today. Todokanai TL generalizes this into a brash old tone, deleting the address-form transition that marks his recovered intimacy.
findings.japanese:
「さっきから春希くん、わたしのこと、お前って言ってる。
ずっと、言ってるよ…」
findings.todokanai: "Haruki-kun… It's the same brash tone you had in the past… Ever since we met today…"

findings.highlight: When the conductor, caught in the moment, moved to embrace Kazusa,
findings.evidenceJa: その後、指揮者が勢い余ってかずさに抱きつきそうになり、けれど彼女は、明らかにそれを予測していた動作で、彼の足を思い切り踏んで撃退した。
findings.explanation: Kazusa predicts the attempted embrace, stamps hard on Dupre's foot, and drives him off. Todokanai TL omits the entire physical punchline that explains why the hall reacts most strongly on the next line.
findings.japanese:
その後、指揮者が勢い余ってかずさに抱きつきそうになり、
けれど彼女は、明らかにそれを予測していた動作で、
彼の足を思い切り踏んで撃退した。
findings.todokanai: When the conductor, caught in the moment, moved to embrace Kazusa,

findings.highlight: I think that's the reason everything went so much better than usual.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ええと…周りが素晴らしい方ばかりでしたので、そのおかげで普段以上のものが出せたと思います。デュプレ氏とオケの皆さんに感謝しています」
findings.explanation: Kazusa concludes by thanking Dupre and every member of the orchestra. Todokanai TL omits the public gratitude that demonstrates her social and professional growth.
findings.japanese:
「ええと…周りが素晴らしい方ばかりでしたので、
そのおかげで普段以上のものが出せたと思います。
デュプレ氏とオケの皆さんに感謝しています」
findings.todokanai: "Um… I was working with a lot of amazing people, so I think that's the reason everything went so much better than usual.

findings.highlight: neither predictable or unpredictable
findings.evidenceJa: 携帯に表示されていたのは、今かかってくるには、当然でも不自然でもある名前だった。
findings.explanation: Fluegel's name is both natural and strange as a caller at this exact moment. Todokanai TL changes the deliberate simultaneous paradox into a logically different 'neither/nor' construction.
findings.japanese:
携帯に表示されていたのは、
今かかってくるには、当然でも不自然でもある名前だった。
findings.todokanai: A name appeared on my phone; a name neither predictable or unpredictable.

findings.highlight: through his thick German accent
findings.evidenceJa: けれど、そんな怪物老人の聞き取りにくいドイツ語は、お祝いのメッセージとしては、切羽詰まりすぎていて…
findings.explanation: Kazusa is struggling to understand the old man's spoken German. Todokanai TL instead says he is speaking through a German accent, changing the language itself into a manner of pronouncing some other language.
findings.japanese:
けれど、そんな怪物老人の聞き取りにくいドイツ語は、
お祝いのメッセージとしては、切羽詰まりすぎていて…
findings.todokanai: But this formidable old man, through his thick German accent, sounded far too panicked to be congratulating me…

findings.highlight: What do you mean, discharged
findings.evidenceJa: 「なに勝手に退院してんだよ！？」
findings.explanation: Kazusa angrily asks why Youko discharged herself from hospital without permission. Todokanai TL reacts to the abstract fact of discharge and removes Youko's unilateral action.
findings.japanese: 「なに勝手に退院してんだよ！？」
findings.todokanai: "What do you mean, discharged!?"

findings.highlight: under the watchful eye of her graceful mother
findings.evidenceJa: 「余裕…？さすが、英才教育を受けて親の七光でのし上がったお嬢ちゃまは物腰も余裕ですこと」
findings.explanation: Youko sarcastically calls Kazusa a sheltered young lady who rose through elite education and her parent's reflected glory. Todokanai TL replaces the nepotism accusation with benign maternal supervision.
findings.japanese:
「余裕…？
さすが、英才教育を受けて親の七光でのし上がった
お嬢ちゃまは物腰も余裕ですこと」
findings.todokanai: "Easy…? Of course, a little princess who got the very best education under the watchful eye of her graceful mother would indeed have it easy."

findings.highlight: making a full recovery
findings.evidenceJa: 「復帰するつもりなのかよ！それも、年内だって？」
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks whether Youko intends to return to performance before year's end. Todokanai TL turns 復帰 into full medical recovery, which is neither promised nor the immediate subject.
findings.japanese:
「復帰するつもりなのかよ！
それも、年内だって？」
findings.todokanai: "You're planning on making a full recovery!? Within the year, no less?"

findings.highlight: We'll play in the same venue, and play the same song in front of the same audience…
findings.evidenceJa: 「もちろん、あなたも出るのよ？同じ会場で、同じ曲弾いて、同じ客に判断してもらうの。…どちらが上かをね！」
findings.explanation: Youko finishes that the same audience will judge which pianist is superior. Todokanai TL omits the competitive verdict that motivates Kazusa's refusal and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「もちろん、あなたも出るのよ？
同じ会場で、同じ曲弾いて、同じ客に判断してもらうの。
…どちらが上かをね！」
findings.todokanai: "Of course, you'll be performing too. We'll play in the same venue, and play the same song in front of the same audience…

findings.highlight: out of nothing but spite, fully recovered
findings.evidenceJa: しかも相手は、娘のピアノに嫉妬して、本気でやっかんで、自分の病気を忘れて完全復帰をもくろむ、数時間前まで病室のベッドで寝込んでいた女性。
findings.explanation: Youko was bedridden only hours earlier yet now forgets her illness and plots a full comeback out of jealous rivalry. Todokanai TL says spite has already fully cured her, turning intention into medical fact and dropping the timing.
findings.japanese:
しかも相手は、娘のピアノに嫉妬して、本気でやっかんで、
自分の病気を忘れて完全復帰をもくろむ、
数時間前まで病室のベッドで寝込んでいた女性。
findings.todokanai: My opponent would be a bedridden woman so full of jealousy of her own daughter that she, out of nothing but spite, fully recovered.

findings.highlight: A pale face
findings.evidenceJa: そんな、真っ白になった頭に、最近では留守電の声でお馴染みの、どこか懐かしい言葉が被さる。
findings.explanation: The familiar words intrude upon Kazusa's mind after her head has gone completely blank. Todokanai TL invents a pale face as the speaking subject and loses the mental-state image.
findings.japanese:
そんな、真っ白になった頭に、
最近では留守電の声でお馴染みの、
どこか懐かしい言葉が被さる。
findings.todokanai: A pale face, speaking oddly familiar words in a voice I've only heard on the answering machine recently.

findings.highlight: Secure a venue for us by New Year's. A big one preferably!
findings.evidenceJa: 「早速だけど美代ちゃん初仕事よ。年末にホール押さえて頂戴。なるべく大きいの！かずさのマネージャー就任なんて後回しでいいから」
findings.explanation: Youko adds that formalizing Miyoko's appointment as Kazusa's manager can wait. Todokanai TL omits the role that explains why Miyoko crossed to Europe and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「早速だけど美代ちゃん初仕事よ。
年末にホール押さえて頂戴。なるべく大きいの！
かずさのマネージャー就任なんて後回しでいいから」
findings.todokanai: "Let's begin with your first job right away then, Miyo-chan. Secure a venue for us by New Year's. A big one preferably!

findings.highlight: allow non-invitees to join
findings.evidenceJa: 「いいじゃんいいじゃん、こんなお祭り企画、どうせ飛び入り参加もＯＫなんだろ？」
findings.explanation: Haruki says a festival-style live show surely permits surprise walk-on performers. Todokanai TL turns the musical participation into uninvited people being allowed into a party.
findings.japanese:
「いいじゃんいいじゃん、
こんなお祭り企画、
どうせ飛び入り参加もＯＫなんだろ？」
findings.todokanai: "Oh, don't worry about it. These kinds of parties allow non-invitees to join, don't they?"

findings.highlight: wanted to hear those words
findings.evidenceJa: 「も～、そんなこと言わない。どうせあんたも聴きたいくせに～」
findings.explanation: Haruki teases that Tomo wants to hear Setsuna sing too. Todokanai TL makes Tomo want to hear an unspecified set of words, losing the immediate performance referent.
findings.japanese:
「も～、そんなこと言わない。
どうせあんたも聴きたいくせに～」
findings.todokanai: "Oh, don't be like that. You know you wanted to hear those words too."

findings.highlight: I'll make it my goal to attend the next live show.
findings.evidenceJa: 「無理して悪化させるわけにはいかないからな。頑張って完治して、目標は次のライブだ。その時までに、何が何でも復調してやる」
findings.explanation: Haruki vows that by the next live show he will recover his condition no matter what. Todokanai TL omits the emphatic deadline and leaves the quotation open, weakening the joke in the reply telling him not to strive.
findings.japanese:
「無理して悪化させるわけにはいかないからな。
頑張って完治して、目標は次のライブだ。
その時までに、何が何でも復調してやる」
findings.todokanai: "I shouldn't go out of my way to worsen my symptoms. I'll do my best to get better first, and then I'll make it my goal to attend the next live show.

findings.highlight: After the first toast
findings.evidenceJa: 「あと、酒は強要はなしだよ？乾杯からウーロン茶ＯＫだよ？」
findings.explanation: The organizer explicitly permits oolong tea starting with the opening toast. Todokanai TL permits it only after the first toast, implying the initial drink is still compulsory.
findings.japanese:
「あと、酒は強要はなしだよ？
乾杯からウーロン茶ＯＫだよ？」
findings.todokanai: "Also, no forcing anyone to drink alcohol, okay? After the first toast, you'll allow people to drink nothing but oolong tea."

findings.highlight: accepting kind thoughts
findings.evidenceJa: 「それとご厚志の方はまだまだ受け付けてますので、遠慮なく声を掛けてくださいね浜田さん～」
findings.explanation: The group is still accepting monetary contributions toward the celebration and pointedly solicits Hamada. Todokanai TL translates the euphemism as accepting kind thoughts, making the request unintelligible.
findings.japanese:
「それとご厚志の方はまだまだ受け付けてますので、
遠慮なく声を掛けてくださいね浜田さん～」
findings.todokanai: "We're still accepting kind thoughts, so feel free to speak up at any time, Hamada-san."

findings.highlight: crazy enough to rival the chief editor
findings.evidenceJa: 「普通なら編集長に掛け合うくらいやると思うけどな～」
findings.explanation: The speaker says Hamada would normally go so far as to petition the editor-in-chief for funds. Todokanai TL instead says he is crazy enough to rival the editor-in-chief, inventing competition.
findings.japanese: 「普通なら編集長に掛け合うくらいやると思うけどな～」
findings.todokanai: "Normally you're crazy enough to rival the chief editor when it comes to this kinda thing."

findings.highlight: That's rich, considering you've been trying to get with me since middle school!
findings.evidenceJa: 「お前、中学の時からずっとあたし狙ってたくせに！一度寝たら興味失うって本当だったのかよ！？」
findings.explanation: Io continues by asking whether the rumor that Takeya loses interest after sleeping with a woman once was true. Todokanai TL omits the sexual accusation that triggers his demand for her source and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「お前、中学の時からずっとあたし狙ってたくせに！
一度寝たら興味失うって本当だったのかよ！？」
findings.todokanai: "That's rich, considering you've been trying to get with me since middle school!

findings.highlight: get permission from the higher ups!
findings.evidenceJa: 「だからこそ上に掛け合ってくれって言ってるんじゃないですか！副編でも、編集長でも、局長でも、なんなら社長でも！」
findings.explanation: Haruki lists every level Hamada should petition: deputy editor, editor-in-chief, division head, even the company president. Todokanai TL omits the escalating list and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「だからこそ
上に掛け合ってくれって言ってるんじゃないですか！
副編でも、編集長でも、局長でも、なんなら社長でも！」
findings.todokanai: "That's why I'm telling you to get permission from the higher ups!

findings.highlight: you'll comfort me. I'll come back to you every time.
findings.evidenceJa: 「大丈夫…何度再発しても、お前が癒してくれる。そのたびに俺は、戻ってくるさ」
findings.explanation: Haruki says Setsuna will heal him whenever he relapses and each time he will return to himself or recover. Todokanai TL weakens healing to comfort and turns recovery into relationally coming back to Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
「大丈夫…
何度再発しても、お前が癒してくれる。
そのたびに俺は、戻ってくるさ」
findings.todokanai: "It's okay… No matter how many times I relapse, you'll comfort me. I'll come back to you every time."

findings.highlight: neither in a good or bad way either
findings.evidenceJa: 「いい意味でも、悪い意味でもね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna says they remain unchanged in both good ways and bad. Todokanai TL's defective double-negative construction says neither applies, reversing the inclusive contrast.
findings.japanese: 「いい意味でも、悪い意味でもね」
findings.todokanai: "And neither in a good or bad way either."
